morphology.look_here_first: Start with the basal rosette and habitat: rounded to cordate/lyrate leaves on long petioles in shaded Ashe-juniper woodland, then confirm the red tubular flower.

confusers.separator: Both can be red. Cedar sage is rosetted and usually low in shaded juniper habitat; S. coccinea is taller with broad deltoid/ovate leaves along the stem.
